create_rectangle: create a SARIF Rectangle dataclass instance to represent an area within an image with top, bottom, left, right coordinates
build_rectangle_with_message: build a SARIF Rectangle with optional message and property bag for image area diagnostics
test_rectangle_fields: test the Rectangle dataclass fields top, bottom, left, right, message, properties are optional floats or objects
summarize_rectangle_schema: summarize the Rectangle dataclass schema for SARIF image area representation with coordinate fields
review_rectangle_dataclass: review the Rectangle dataclass structure for SARIF diagnostics with optional coordinate and metadata fields
